description.html: The artificial plant with pink flower has slender green stems with narrow leaves and a small pink flower near the top. It stands on a low, dark base that is easy to hide among stones or in the substrate.

An artificial plant does not wilt, needs no lighting or fertilizer and does not affect water parameters, so it is a good choice for beginners and for aquariums with fish that nibble or uproot live plants. It gives smaller fish, fry and shrimp cover and a place to rest.

Its airy shape does not block the view of the fish, so the plant looks good in the middle of the aquarium or in front of a dark background. The pink flower is a subtle detail that freshens up an all-green decor. During regular maintenance, take the plant out and rinse it with lukewarm water, removing algae with a soft brush and no detergents. Rinse it before putting it in the aquarium for the first time as well. Browse our other decorations and equipment.
